headline: Intel Plunges in Major Selloff as PC Weakness and Memory Prices Weigh
summary: Intel experienced its worst trading day in decades, wiping out $140 billion in market value. The company's PC business faces pressure from rising memory-chip prices and tighter corporate IT budgets.
why: Intel is one of the world's largest semiconductor manufacturers and a major component of benchmark equity indices, serving as a key bellwether for the global computing industry.

impacts.name: Intel
impacts.why: Intel shares experienced their steepest single-day decline in decades amid PC market weakness.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Intel suffered a sharp selloff after headwinds in its PC division, driven by memory-chip prices and reduced corporate IT laptop spending, dented investor sentiment.
